question: By which of the following authors is the English novel ‘Three Men in a Boat’ written?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jerome K Jerome**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Three Men in a Boat** is an English comic novel written by Jerome K Jerome, first published in 1889.
 
• The novel narrates a humorous account of a boating holiday taken by three friends—Jerome, George, and Harris—along with the dog Montmorency on the River Thames.
 
• Originally intended as a guidebook for Thames River travelers, the book is noted for its witty humor and timeless appeal.
 
• The novel was an instant success upon its release and continues to be regarded as one of the classics of English literature.
 
• Jerome K Jerome wrote the book in a semi-autobiographical style, drawing on his own experiences and observations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jerome K Jerome:**

 
 
• Born on May 2, 1859, in Walsall, England, Jerome Klapka Jerome was a prolific English author and humorist.
 
• Apart from "Three Men in a Boat," his other notable works include "Idle Thoughts of an Idle Fellow" and "Three Men on the Bummel."
 
• He was known for his sharp wit, observational humor, and engaging writing style.
 
 
 
• **Comic Novel Genre:**
 
 
• A comic novel is a literary genre that uses humor as a central element to engage readers.
 
• It often includes satire, irony, and exaggeration to critique social norms or human behavior.
 
 
 
• **River Thames:**
 
 
• The River Thames is the longest river entirely in England, flowing through London and several historical landmarks.
 
• It has been a source of inspiration for numerous literary works, including "Three Men in a Boat."
 
 
 
• **Legacy of the Novel:**
 
 
• "Three Men in a Boat" has been adapted into several films, television shows, and theatrical productions.
 
• Its humor and relatability have ensured its popularity across generations and cultures.
